Hinoki logo options

The annual rings you chose, joined with the Hinoki wordmark. Six ways to bring them together, each shown on light, dark, red and black so you can see how it behaves. Tell me the number you like best.

1

The red dot on the first i becomes the annual rings. The last i keeps a plain ink dot.
